PainterlyNPR__UndoHistory__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: How many steps are kept, when an edit counts as finished, the keys, the buttons' words and icons. Adam, 30-Oct-2026: 'Add a comprehensive user undo / redo caching system ... store 100 undos and 100 redos then add control +z and control + y as keyboard mappings'.
PainterlyNPR__UndoHistory__Config__Meta.Source: New in v0.7.4 (30-Oct-2026), after ValeVision 3D's Layout Editor history (Na__LayoutEditor__History__ 1.7.0) and its key map's Edit__ bindings (Na__Hotkeys__DrawingTabs__.json)

PainterlyNPR__UndoHistory__Config__Histo.MaxNote: Adam, 30-Oct-2026: '100 undos and 100 redos'. The oldest step goes when a 101st is made; a new edit after an undo clears the redos, as everywhere.
PainterlyNPR__UndoHistory__Config__Histo.SettleNote: An edit becomes a step once nothing has changed for this long and no pointer button is held: a slider drag, a point dragged on the sheet or a held arrow key is one step, however long it lasted.
PainterlyNPR__UndoHistory__Config__Histo.TypingSettleNote: In a text box a pause between words is not the end of the edit: typing is one step until it stops this long, or the box is left.
PainterlyNPR__UndoHistory__Config__Histo.CheckNote: A quiet look for a change no click or key announced (a saved set-up or an opened file that finished loading after its click had settled).
PainterlyNPR__UndoHistory__Config__Histo.ChunkNote: Parts of a step this long or longer (as JSON) are stored once and shared by every step that holds them, so 200 steps of a drawing with many points, assets and materials stay small.

PainterlyNPR__UndoHistory__Config__Keys.Note: The edit keys, in the form of the Layout Editor's key map: each binding an Id, a Label and Enabled; Keys are KeyboardEvent.key values; Modifiers must be exactly those held (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Meta). Bindings are tried in order and the first enabled match wins. Read anywhere on the page, except while a text box has the keyboard: there the box's own undo works on its words.

Bindings.Label: Redo (Cmd + Shift + Z, a Mac keyboard)

PainterlyNPR__UndoHistory__Config__Keys.RepeatNote: A held Ctrl + Z steps back once each this many milliseconds at most, so a long hold never piles up rebuilds.

PainterlyNPR__UndoHistory__Config__Label.Note: What the buttons' titles call a step: one control's own label under its part of the drawing, else that part, else Several settings. {step}, {name} and {keys} are filled in.
